content.text:
Tax year 2026: no repayment cap. No repayment cap for tax years beginning after December 31, 2025. P.L. 119-21 (One Big Beautiful Bill Act) sec. 71305 struck sec. 36B(f)(2)(B). You repay the full excess advance premium tax credit, whatever your income (IRS PTC Q&A, Q31). Amount to repay: $5,000.00.

General information, not tax advice. The Marketplace and Form 8962 decide the official amounts. Benchmark (second lowest cost silver) premiums vary by ZIP code, age and household; get yours from HealthCare.gov or your state Marketplace.
